findings.claim: The project encoded a clear dependency DAG from three marketplace scans to database construction, email preparation, dealer contact, viewing coordination and final purchase. Every inspected task is pending, so this is planning/orchestration structure rather than evidence of completed autonomous car purchasing.
findings.current_implication: Dependency-aware work packages are reusable, but task state must be separated from effect/outcome receipts. A pending or merely scheduled task cannot satisfy a capability or completion predicate.

findings.claim: The stored browser screenshot shows Willhaben blocked at an open cookie-consent dialog in front of the vehicle search UI, not a completed marketplace scan or result set.
findings.current_implication: Browser execution needs explicit modal/consent detection, observable step postconditions, retries/escalation and success evidence. Navigation-to-page must not be scored as task completion.

findings.claim: PROJECT.md says the fully autonomous plan and automations were activated, but all executable task-state leaves remain pending and the sole visible browser artifact is at a consent gate. The prose status therefore overstates execution evidence.
findings.current_implication: Capability/status claims require evidence-class provenance and outcome receipts; planning prose and configuration state must not promote runtime success.

findings.claim: The subtree includes a 122240-byte browser state artifact. Its session contents are intentionally not reproduced in RAE.
findings.current_implication: Browser profiles/session stores require secret and cookie sanitization, capability scoping and expiry handling before archival replay or shared research ingestion.

credit.reason: The autonomous purchase capability was not demonstrated. Useful value is the dependency model and concrete consent-gate failure.

progress_accounting.reason: Local closure does not freeze the combined Level-0 denominator.

cross_branch_feedback.harness: Add browser-modal/consent handling tests and require postcondition receipts for every action; preserve task DAG separately from outcome state.
cross_branch_feedback.frank: Use dependency-aware planning but do not infer capability from configured automation or project prose.
cross_branch_feedback.claygraph: Represent task plan, execution event, observed effect and final outcome as separate provenance-linked nodes/claims.
cross_branch_feedback.unifieddb: Keep browser session secrets isolated from durable task/evidence records.
